resources.string: Mark it as done and Speak Studio won\'t show it again.

No transcript this time, so these numbers and notes come from your voice alone.

Mukhar couldn\'t write a transcript: there\'s no speech-to-text on this phone yet, or your Deepgram or Sarvam key didn\'t work. So your pace (≈) and pauses were measured from your voice. Offline speech arrives in the next update.
You were offline, so the transcript wasn\'t written. Your pace (≈) and pauses were measured from your voice.
The speech-to-text service didn\'t work this time, so your pace (≈) and pauses were measured from your voice.
The recording was deleted, so this talk can\'t get a transcript. The numbers below stay.
Fillers, word variety and the coach\'s line-by-line notes need a transcript. Your recording stays on this phone so it can be written later (Settings → Recordings).
Fillers, word variety and the coach\'s line-by-line notes need a transcript. Your recording stays on this phone, and the transcript is written as soon as you add a key.
When recordings go over the limit, the oldest are deleted first. Your reports, numbers and notes always stay. Talks still waiting for analysis are never deleted automatically.
Mukhar deletes each recording after its report, unless you chose to keep it or its transcript is still to be written.
The report and numbers stay. Only the audio is deleted.
This talk hasn\'t been analysed yet. Without the recording it can\'t be.
%1$s of audio will be deleted. Reports and numbers stay. Talks waiting for analysis can\'t be analysed afterwards.
